facts.fact: The Minister of State Domains says the ONPF has finished installing its comprehensive IT system and extended it to all its regional offices.
The Minister says the ONPF's IT system has been generalised to all its regional administrations.
The Minister says ONPF publicity services are now delivered online, including certificates of ownership, co-ownership, non-ownership and registration, via the updated cpf.gov.tn site.
